cues: Water moves to more negative potential, and xylem sap is pulled under tension.
Potassium opens stomata; A B A closes them.
The light reaction makes ATP, NADPH and oxygen from water.
Calvin needs three ATP and two NADPH per carbon dioxide; C4 separates steps in space, CAM in time.
Respiration gives thirty to thirty-two ATP; R Q is about zero point seven for fat.
And five hormones; tropisms are growth, Mimosa is turgor.
